library(gridExtra)

hist(magic_guys$length,
     breaks = 10,
     col = "lightblue",
     border = "white",
     main = "Distribution of Length",
     xlab = "Length",
     ylab = "Frequency")

par(mfrow = c(1, 3))

hist(magic_guys$length,
     breaks = 5,
     main = "Breaks = 5",
     col = "lightblue")

hist(magic_guys$length,
     breaks = 10,
     main = "Breaks = 10",
     col = "lightgreen")

hist(magic_guys$length,
     breaks = 20,
     main = "Breaks = 20",
     col = "lightpink")

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

p_hist <- ggplot(magic_guys, aes(x = length)) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 10,
    fill = "steelblue",
    color = "white",
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Length",
    x = "Length",
    y = "Frequency"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p_hist


p_hist_species <- ggplot(magic_guys, aes(x = length)) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 15,
    fill = "steelblue",
    color = "white"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ species) +
  labs(
    title = "Length Distribution by Species",
    x = "Length",
    y = "Frequency"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

p_hist_species

for (bw in c(5, 10, 20)) {
  p <- ggplot(magic_guys, aes(x = length)) +
    geom_histogram(
      binwidth = bw,
      fill = "steelblue",
      color = "white"
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ species) +
    labs(title = paste("Binwidth =", bw)) +
    theme_minimal()

  print(p)
}

boxplot(length ~ species,
        data = magic_guys,
        col = c("lightblue", "lightgreen"),
        main = "Length by Species",
        xlab = "Species",
        ylab = "Length")

p_box <- ggplot(magic_guys,
                aes(x = species, y = length, fill = species)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(
    title = "Length by Species",
    x = "Species",
    y = "Length"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

p_box


p_box_jitter <- ggplot(magic_guys,
                       aes(x = species, y = length, fill = species)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    alpha = 0.5,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.15,
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(
    title = "Length Distribution by Species",
    x = "Species",
    y = "Length"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

p_box_jitter
